Table 3, 4, 5 and 6 show the full results presented in this paper. We only reported the results with the best tried learning rate. We run all experiments on 8 Nvidia A100 GPUs. Each example is cut off with 1024 sub-tokens. On each dataset, we train the model for one epoch and select the run with the best learning rate. Each training takes about 10 GPU hours for a 7B model, 15 hours for a 13B model and 30 hours for a 33B model. Table 2: Dataset Examples. Musique contains at least 2 passages per question as all questions require multi-hop inferences. The other datasets contain only 1 passage per question.
